feature: ORDER BY row ordering and LIMIT row capping over row-projection results

scenarios.name: type-scan projection ordered ascending by a data-lane field
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/return-orderby (ascending order on a field)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) RETURN n.entity_id AS id, n.data.severity_score AS sev ORDER BY sev

scenarios.name: type-scan projection ordered descending with LIMIT — top-3 by severity
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/return-skip-limit (descending order with LIMIT top-N)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) RETURN n.entity_id AS id, n.data.severity_score AS sev ORDER BY sev DESC LIMIT 3

scenarios.name: multi-key ORDER BY orders left-to-right by key then key
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) RETURN n.entity_id AS id, n.data.kind AS kind, n.data.severity_score AS sev ORDER BY kind, sev DESC

scenarios.name: ORDER BY a tied key resolves stably via the deterministic tiebreak
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) RETURN n.entity_id AS id, n.data.kind AS kind ORDER BY kind

scenarios.name: LIMIT zero returns no rows
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id LIMIT 0

scenarios.name: LIMIT larger than the result set returns every row
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id LIMIT 999

scenarios.name: COUNT scoreboard ordered by the aggregated column descending
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/return-orderby (order by an aggregated column)
scenarios.query: MATCH (h)-[:PG_LINKS]->(n) RETURN h.entity_id AS source_id, COUNT(n) AS out_degree ORDER BY out_degree DESC

scenarios.name: COUNT scoreboard capped with LIMIT — highest-degree hub only
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/return-skip-limit (LIMIT 1 over an ordered aggregate)
scenarios.query: MATCH (h)-[:PG_LINKS]->(n) RETURN h.entity_id AS source_id, COUNT(n) AS out_degree ORDER BY out_degree DESC LIMIT 1

scenarios.name: LIMIT without ORDER BY caps in the executor's deterministic default order
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) RETURN n.entity_id AS id, n.name AS label LIMIT 2
